Package com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring.autoconfigure

Class SystemdProperties.StatusProviders

java.lang.Object
com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd.spring.autoconfigure.SystemdProperties.StatusProviders
Enclosing class:
SystemdProperties
public static class SystemdProperties.StatusProviders extends Object
The built-in status providers, under their keys: each can be enabled or disabled, and some can be configured further.
